d: Join a fast-paced vehicle testing and mapping operations team supporting innovative automotive and mapping technology projects across major markets in the Middle East.

The Contract Driver – Vehicle Testing & Mapping Operations role is responsible for safely operating assigned vehicles to support vehicle testing, road mapping, route validation, and data collection activities across designated locations. Drivers will be required to follow pre-assigned routes and testing instructions, operate vehicles for approximately 8 hours daily, and achieve a minimum daily driving target of 200 kilometers, subject to operational and road conditions. This role requires individuals who are disciplined, safety-conscious, detail-oriented, and comfortable with extended driving schedules. Successful candidates must demonstrate strong navigation skills, the ability to follow precise route instructions, and the discipline to complete assigned driving activities without unauthorized route deviations.
Safely operate assigned vehicles for vehicle testing, road mapping, route validation, and operational activities.
Complete a minimum target of 200 kilometers of assigned driving per day, subject to approved operational adjustments.
Strictly follow assigned routes, navigation instructions, testing procedures, and driving schedules.
Avoid unauthorized detours, route deviations, or interruptions that may affect testing accuracy and project deliverables.
Operate vehicles across highways, urban roads, residential areas, and other designated testing environments.
Support day, evening, overnight, and weekend shifts as required.
Travel to designated testing locations within the assigned country or deployment area.
Proficiently use GPS-based navigation and digital mapping applications to follow assigned routes.
Monitor navigation instructions and report discrepancies, inaccessible roads, road closures, or route-related issues.
Ensure accurate execution of assigned routes and designated driving activities.
Follow specific client instructions related to mapping, vehicle testing, and road coverage.
Immediately report any technical or navigation-related issues affecting route execution.
Conduct pre-trip and post-trip vehicle inspections.
Ensure the assigned vehicle is roadworthy and properly maintained before and after each shift.
Immediately report vehicle defects, warning indicators, incidents, or unusual vehicle behavior.
Comply with local traffic laws, road safety regulations, and company policies.
Observe required rest periods and fatigue management procedures.
Maintain the cleanliness and general condition of the assigned vehicle.
Maintain accurate daily driving logs, mileage records, route completion records, and operational reports.
Provide regular driving progress updates to the assigned Project Coordinator.
Promptly report incidents, delays, route deviations, vehicle issues, and operational concerns.
Complete all required documentation and testing-related reports within established deadlines.
Maintain clear and professional communication with the Project Coordinator and operations team.
Strictly adhere to assigned schedules, route instructions, and operational procedures.
Attend mandatory safety briefings, driver orientations, and project-specific training.
Maintain confidentiality regarding client information, testing activities, and project-related data.
Demonstrate punctuality, reliability, accountability, and professional conduct at all times.
Cooperate with Project Coordinators and other operational personnel to ensure successful project execution.
